{"from": "FR!sky Paperclip ", "to": ["{{1.email}}"], "subject": "Your FR!sky Paperclip seat key", "html": "

Hi {{1.name}},

Your FR!sky Paperclip seat is ready.

FRSKY-PC-{{upper(substr(sha256(string(coalesce(1.email;1.id;now)));1;4))}}-{{upper(substr(sha256(string(coalesce(1.id;1.email;now))+string(now));1;4))}}

Paste it in the extension: side panel \u2192 Options \u2192 Seat key \u2192 SAVE.
Grok runs free on your own xAI key; the seat unlocks the GPT mind. Your keys never leave your machine.

Receipt lives in Whop. Lost keys: reply to this email.

\u2014 Frisky Developments

"}
